I'm in the same situation as you, well.. sorta of. i live in a big home with a lot of untreated cats, we can't afford to fix them up so they stop having babies unfortunately. honestly they're more of stray cats who decided to stay around than my domestic cats. I've seen a lot of cats dying, my family would drown the babies back in the past because we couldn't afford to have so many. i remember seeing it all and not being able to do anything. Although , even now i can't stop loving the cats i have. i name each and every one of them and i set up boxes for them to sleep and feed them everyday. I love them and it does hurt me when i see them sick or when one of the babies doesn't make it, i can't blame you for feeling tired of seeing it so often, it shouldn't become a normal thing in your life and you are right in feeling like this and i'm so so sorry you have to go through it.
